**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/24 (Wed) 16:19  
[EVENT] User is planning to host a board game party for their birthday next month.  
[PREFERENCE] User wants a mix of old favorites and new games for the party.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended classic party favorites: Ticket to Ride, Settlers of Catan, Pictionary, Scattergories, What Do You Meme.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended newer games for a large group: Codenames, Deception: Murder in Hong Kong, Mysterium, Werewolf, Forbidden Island/Forbidden Desert.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided additional recommendations: Wits & Wagers, Junk Art, Spyfall, Taboo, Monikers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised considering the age range and interests of guests when selecting games.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested having a few games available for smaller groups to play while others are playing the main game.  
[PREFERENCE] User likes some of the suggestions, especially Codenames, as they have had a great experience with it.  
[EVENT] User recently tried Azul at a board game cafe and loved it.  
[EVENT] User and their sister started a monthly game challenge where they take turns choosing a game to play and learn together.  
[EVENT] Last month, the sister chose Settlers of Catan, which the user had never played before and enjoyed.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for other strategic games similar to Azul and Settlers of Catan.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended games similar to Azul: Sagrada, Star Realms, 7 Wonders.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended games similar to Settlers of Catan: Carcassonne, El Grande, Puerto Rico.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided other strategic game recommendations: Pandemic, Ticket to Ride: Rails & Sails, Scythe, Gloomhaven, Terraforming Mars.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant noted that these games vary in complexity and gameplay.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant encouraged user to let them know if they are looking for something specific for more tailored recommendations.  
[EVENT] User has been watching YouTube tutorials to learn the rules of Carcassonne and Pandemic.  
[EVENT] User recently bought Pandemic at a garage sale.  
[EVENT] User is excited to try out Pandemic with friends.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for beginners playing Carcassonne: start simple, focus on placement, build cities carefully, use followers wisely, block opponents, keep an eye on the board, don't worry about perfection, teach others, start with a small game, and have fun.
